expected_level_description: You can: - maintain secure configuration and accurate information - control IT assets in one or more areas - verify the location and state of IT assets
You can: - explain availability and capacity management processes
You can: - analyse and assess the impact of change - document change requests - action changes from change requests

You can: - contribute to the work of others - motivate and empower teams - create the right environment for teams to work in, and can identify the best team makeup depending on the situation - recognise and deal with issues

You can: - show an awareness of developing process efficiency and common ways in which processes are optimised - support specific activities to improve development processes - spot or identify obvious deficiencies
You can: - explain the basic principles of IT standard continuity management processes and procedures
You can: - identify and register incidents, gathering the required information and allocating it to the appropriate channel
You can: - show an awareness of problem resolution processes - pass problems on to your team

You can: - investigate problems in systems, processes and services, with an understanding of the level of a problem, for example, strategic, tactical or operational - contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures
You can: - show an awareness of different products and services
You can: - show you have a Level 3 service management framework qualification
You can: - show an awareness of the relevant subject matter and a high level understanding of what it involves
You can: - show an awareness or understanding of user experience analysis and its principles - explain the purpose of user stories and the focus on user needs

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
